anya: Quick coordination — planning a microcohort canary for svc-infer v2.2 on Tue 2026-03-23 18:00 UTC. Goal: validate perf/quality on low-traffic slices before a wider ramp. Proposed ramp: 1% -> 5% -> 20% over ~45m. Cohorts: apac-prod-small, eu-stable-smoke, na-shadow-mini. Who can own deploy, smoke, and rollback readiness?

matt: I can run the deploy and watch the rollout. ETA to kick off at 18:00 UTC is good for me. I’ll follow the phased ramp and manually approve the 5% and 20% steps.

devon: I’ll own smoke checks. Quick checklist I’ll run after each step:
- sanity: 5 sample inferences across each cohort
- perf: p95 latency < 180ms, p99 < 400ms for short prompts
- errors: 5xx rate < 0.1% and no new client-facing 4xx spikes
- accuracy smoke: run repr-set of 50 prompts; fail if >2% regression on key metric

I’ll post short results as comments. Commands I’ll use:
```bash
# basic smoke request (NA)
curl -sS -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD" \
  -d '{"model":"svc-infer:v2.2","input":"summarize: short"}' \
  https://api.redwood-inference.internal/v1/generate | jq .
# perf check (run locust or k6 in rps=10 for 60s)
```

lina: Rollback plan: if any smoke gate fails or error rate >0.2% for >3m, rollback to svc-infer:v2.1 and scale down canary to 0%. Steps:
1) matt triggers rollout rollback in console -> route traffic back to v2.1 (automated)
2) ops-oncall (paging list) gets pinged automatically; SRE monitors will block further ramps
3) postmortem owner assigned within 24h if rollback triggered
Link to runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/canary-rollbacks (shared)

sre-bot: Deploy job queued: #4578 scheduled by matt for 2026-03-23T18:00:00Z. Canary slices: apac-prod-small, eu-stable-smoke, na-shadow-mini. Notifying oncall and creating temporary alert filters for the test window.

matt: Confirmed. I’ll annotate deployment with the roll-forward signal and keep the manual approvals at 5% and 20%. I’ll also attach the canary id: canary-1969-micro. If we see steady state after 20m at 5% then we go to 20%.

anya: Thanks — owners noted: matt (deploy), devon (smoke), lina (rollback/runbook). Small checklist for visibility before T-30m:
- matt: upload deploy notes + expected deploy duration
- devon: check repr-set is up-to-date and paste baseline metrics
- lina: confirm alert thresholds and oncall rota are set
- all: ping here when ready (T-10m + T-1m)

I’ll also leave an explicit canary hold message in the console for approval. If anyone needs to shift the time, shout now.

matt: Uploaded notes + estimated window: 18:00–18:50 UTC. Will post canary link when live. :thumbsup:

devon: Repr-set updated and baseline metrics: p95=140ms, error=0.03%. I’ll post a one-line pass/fail after each ramp.

anya: Perfect. I’ll be on standby for stakeholder updates. Good luck — ping here for any emergency rollbacks. :rocket:
